events.sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT r.region_name AS `地区`, SUM(f.order_amount) AS `销售额` FROM fact_order AS f JOIN dim_region AS r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY r.region_name) SELECT `地区`, `销售额`, ROUND(`销售额` / SUM(`销售额`) OVER (), 4) AS `销售额占比` FROM region_sales ORDER BY `销售额` DESC LIMIT 1000

events.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fq.quarter = 'Q1' THEN fq.order_amount END), 0) AS 第一季度销售额, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fq.quarter = 'Q2' THEN fq.order_amount END), 0) AS 第二季度销售额 FROM dim_region AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.region_id, d.quarter, f.order_amount FROM fact_order AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250630) AS fq ON fq.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name ORDER BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000
